text:
Nate R.: Putting together the internal release note for Monday's small rollout. Need concise blurb + explicit model pin statement.
Yara V.: Please call out that the pin map should not be mutated during canary. We saw a forced pinflip last month.
Nate R.: Agreed. Plan: canary at 10% for 20m, 50% for 15m, then promote. Start: Mon 21:45 UTC (Mon 14:45 PT). Change window: 45m.
Omar H.: Also note the downstream embedding refresh that runs after promote — expected ~12-22m depending on shard load. Support should mention potential short-term similarity score drift.
Casey D.: Rollback thresholds proposal: 5m error rate > 1% OR P95 latency increase > 300ms sustained for 10m. Also fail if embedding index job fails or exceeds 30m.
Nate R.: Draft blurb:
"Release v2.3.7 (runtime and cache fixes). Rolling canary Mon 21:45 UTC. Highlights: KV prefetch fix, minor runtime perf, embedding index refresh during promote. Use pinned model references remain stable; do not update pins during the canary. Ops can rollback to v2.3.6 on threshold breach. Expected user impact: brief similarity search quality variance during index refresh."
Yara V.: Add this sentence: "If you use pinned model versions, verify pins after promotion and contact infra@redwood if they differ."
Omar H.: Add the deploy snippet for ops playbook:
```
/deploy canary v2.3.7 --region=eu-central-1 --steps=10,50,100 --watch
/deploy rollback v2.3.7 v2.3.6 --reason="ops-threshold"
```
deploy-bot: queued canary rollout by Nate R. for v2.3.7. See /deploy status 1764211111 for live details.
Casey D.: Quick rollback checklist to include in the internal note:
- run `/deploy rollback v2.3.7 v2.3.6`
- disable canary routing
- post status in #incident-announce
- email support@redwood

Yara V.: Also include links: Canary playbook and Evacuation runbook (wiki).
Nate R.: Links:
- Canary playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/canary-playbook
- Evac runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/evac-runbook

Casey D.: For oncall, list what to watch: spike in 5xx, GPU memory growth on hosts, embedding-job duration/timeouts, KV cache miss spikes.
Omar H.: I'll run a pin dry-run Wed 15:00 UTC and post the pin-check table and any anomalies. If pins mismatch, push by +24h.
Yara V.: For the internal announcement, keep copy tight: 1-line summary, 3 bullets (visible changes, expected user impact, rollback steps), and tag @sre-oncall + @support-lead.
Nate R.: Final ask: signoffs by Sun 20:00 UTC. I'll merge release notes after approvals and hand to Yara for the internal blast.
sre-oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance check passed 1: no overlaps detected. Monitors prewired for thresholds.
deploy-bot: reminder: run deploy from ops CI with `--watch` to enable auto-monitor rollbacks.
Nate R.: Thanks all. Yara, can you do the internal dry-run ordering for broadcast copy?
Yara V.: Yup — I'll send a dry-run message Tue 16:00 UTC and post the pin table here. If green, I'll push the internal blast Mon 12:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
